nodes.text: Just when we thought masks were out of fashion, here comes #HMPV to bring them back in style. Breathe easy, but not too easy. 😷 https://t.co/VO4OWjXcfI

nodes.author: Drdoks
nodes.text:
2️⃣ What is HMPV? 🤔
HMPV is a respiratory virus causing cold & flu-like symptoms 🤒. It mainly affects:

Young children 👶

Older adults 👵

People with weak immune systems 🛡️

nodes.author: Drdoks
nodes.text:
3️⃣ Symptoms to Watch 🩺:

Cough 🤧

Fever 🌡️

Difficulty breathing 😮‍💨
Most cases resolve with proper care, but high-risk groups should stay cautious!

nodes.author: Drdoks
nodes.text:
4️⃣ Transmission 🫂:
Spreads through:

Respiratory droplets 😷

Contact with contaminated surfaces 🖐️

Close contact 🤝

nodes.author: Drdoks
nodes.text:
5️⃣ Prevention is Key 🔑:
✅ Wash hands frequently 🧼
✅ Avoid crowds 🚶‍♂️🚶‍♀️
✅ Ventilate indoor spaces 🪟
✅ Mask up when sick 😷

nodes.author: Drdoks
nodes.text:
6️⃣ Don't Panic 🚫:
Most cases are mild and resolve on their own. Proper hygiene and early care can prevent complications.
